main.description: Lists indexed collections. Pass array filters as repeated query parameters; filters combine with AND, while values in each array are ORed except tagUris, which requires every supplied URI. Authentication is not required.

hasOrganizationRecord.description: Filter by the author's organization/self record; false matches absence regardless of profile presence.

uris.description: Match by collection record AT-URI; this does not select a CID version.

itemUris.description: Match when an embedded item's itemIdentifier.uri equals a supplied AT-URI; matching ignores CID.

tagUris.description: Require every supplied vocabulary-tag AT-URI to occur in record.tags; matching ignores CID and tag records.

sortDirection.description: Direction for (createdAt, uri) ordering; defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum collections per page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response; use the same sortDirection.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A query parameter is invalid or unsupported.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
